name: AdvancedEncryption.WE.LeafView.encryptor_leafGood_failure
title: Direct entry-tail bound for the encryptor-generated trapdoor
statement: For positive dimension M and width sigma at least one, the actual encryptor fails leafGood with probability at most 6 b M 4^(-M) if the entry threshold covers sigma sqrt(M) plus the column-count shift.
